biblical_reference.note: Jezebel was a Phoenician princess, the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians, who married King Ahab of Israel. She is best known for her role as the queen of Israel and for her promotion of Baal worship, which led to the worship of Baal becoming widespread in Israel during her reign
